page.layout: One column of running text, with Roman-numeral paragraph numbers centred above each paragraph. Running head at the top, page number at the top left. Italic references close several paragraphs. A catchword "um" sits at the right below the last line.

main_text.l: XXIII.
Sampson viuas vulpes sibi nexuit, ad qua-
rum caudas alligauit faces, & dimisit eas per
messes allophylorum: per hanc figuram signi-
ficans, quòd improbi & fraudulenti homines,
& maximè hæretici liberam linguam habeant
ad latrandum, sed exitus impeditos, aut reli-
giosa principia, finem verò fraudis suæ incen-
dio deputatum. Eodem ferm.
XXIV.
Multi sunt hæreticorum qui prætendere
volunt corporis continentiam, vt assertionis
suæ fidem testimonio sobriæ carnis acquirant.

l.i: &c. Tom. 4. cap. 14. lib. de Noe & Arca.
